scope: Corrections to the existing Timer Gym browser study and its existing case. Original travel homepage remains active. All changes are local and unpublished.
previousGoalTurn: Progress: native Flex and Promptilo narrow tasks plus Nexus export/restore were observed at their recorded source versions. Starting counts were 72 Done, 37 In progress, 71 Needs evidence.
confirmedRegressionsBefore: Automatic phase transition replaced the focused cue checkbox. The DOM identity assertion failed.
pagehide stopped the interval without settling/rendering pause. A simulated cached pageshow still displayed Running at 00:05 after 1.234 elapsed seconds, where Paused at 00:04 was expected.
changes: Timer controls mount once. Phase, time, button state and cue feedback update in place so a focused cue control survives a phase boundary.
Pause, hidden page and page exit settle elapsed time before stopping. Browser-cache return stays visibly paused. Resume retains fractional remaining time and excludes time away.

Text phase, remaining time, phase position and next phase remain available with colors off and without speech or haptics. The timer role has live announcements off; phase changes use the existing status announcer.

Optional speech checks the window-bound API. Missing, synchronous failure and asynchronous error disable only the cue. Stale callbacks cannot overwrite a paused or reviewed session. No audibility claim is made.
Restart review pauses first and shows the retained phase/time. Keep, Escape and close retain the paused session. Only explicit confirmation resets to Ready; it never starts automatically.
The case distinguishes current browser implementation checks from native background, lock screen, Bluetooth, haptic, assistive-technology and participant evidence.

timerHandlerContracts: Timer projects elapsed time at pause and keeps controls stable between ticks
Timer preserves a focused cue control across an automatic phase change
Timer settles time before page exit and restores a visibly paused session from the browser cache
Timer remains readable without color, browser speech or haptics and keeps a useful completion focus

Timer ignores stale speech callbacks after pausing or opening restart review
Timer restart review retains precise paused time and resets only after explicit confirmation
